newsitem.title: USA: Wisconsin regulators to reconvene on Primergy plan.
newsitem.headline: Wisconsin regulators to reconvene on Primergy plan.

text.p: Wisconsin Public Service Commission is scheduled to meet Tuesday afternoon to discuss this morning's decision by a Dane County Circuit Court judge to temporarily block the panel from considering a merger between Wisconsin Energy Corp and Northern States Power Co.
Judge Richard Callaway earlier issued a writ preventing the commission from deliberating on the merger, which would create a new company called Primergy Corp.
A commision spokesman called the writ a "surprise," adding that the panel is scheduled to reconvene at 1400 EST.
The spokesman said future hearings will be held in a different judge's courtroom.

The writ states that it appears the commission, as accused by attorneys for the Citizens' Utility Board and the Environmental Coalition, is exceeding its statutory powers by proceeding with deliberations without investigating alleged legal violations contained in a motion filed by the Environmental Coalition attorney.
The merger was first announced May 1, 1995.
Wisconsin Energy shares were off 1/8 Tuesday afternoon at 27-1/8. Northern States Power shares were up 3/8 at 47-1/2.
